sections.heading: Ahmedabad District: Where Gujarat's Pharma Industry Concentrates
paragraphs: Gujarat accounts for about a third of India's drug manufacturing and 28 percent of its pharmaceutical exports, with some 3,500 units, around 130 USFDA-certified facilities and more than 52,000 people employed. Ahmedabad district carries a large part of that load, spread over the southern belt toward Changodar and Sarkhej, the GIDC estates of Naroda and Vatva on the east, and Moraiya and Santej at the edges of the city.

The B.V. Patel PERD Centre, a pharmaceutical education and research institute set up in Ahmedabad in 1989, sits inside the same ecosystem, which helps explain why so many formulation, API and sterile plants have clustered here rather than further from the city.

sections.heading: Changodar, Matoda, Naroda and Vatva: Named Plants
paragraphs: Public listings place Aurobindo, Novartis, Gufic and Zim Laboratories at Changodar; Zydus at Sarkhej; Intas at Matoda; Cadila at Dholka; Claris, Dishman and Unichem at Naroda; Nirma, Themis and Parenteral Drugs at Vatva; Indoco at Moraiya; Lincoln at Narol; Cadila Pharmaceuticals and Eris at Santej; and SPARC's research centre at Thaltej.

Matoda also hosts the Zydus Infrastructure pharmaceutical special economic zone, notified across the villages of Matoda, Sari and Chachanvadi Vasna on NH-8A in Sanand taluka. A part denotification under S.O. 5182(E) dated 29 November 2024 is recorded by the Kandla zone's Development Commissioner, showing the zone is still being reshaped.

Beyond the city edge, the same listings put Torrent at Bhat, Biocon at Kadi, Sterling at Bavla and Troikaa at Dehgam, so a single Ahmedabad-based purchasing team may be buying for plants spread across three or four talukas.

sections.heading: Grade and Finish for Ahmedabad Injectable and API Plants
paragraphs: Parenteral makers in Vatva and Changodar run water-for-injection generation and distribution where the Gujarat Food and Drug Control Administration, CDSCO and overseas regulators all expect a validated, cleanable system under Schedule M. For WFI, clean steam condensate and product-contact transfer we propose 316L to ASTM A270 with an SF4 electropolished finish per ASME BPE.

API plants in Naroda and Vatva handle solvents and intermediates where internal smoothness matters less than corrosion resistance and wall thickness; 316L pipe to ASTM A312 in SF1 or mill finish usually suits those headers, and 304L covers utilities. Where chlorides are high, 904L supplied electropolished is an option worth costing.

sections.heading: Specifying an Ahmedabad Order
paragraphs: Ahmedabad buyers often issue one package that spans an SEZ export block and a domestic block in the same group. Splitting the line list by plant, system and finish, and stating OD, wall, length and the governing standard, lets us return a priced offer within 24 hours with each section shown separately.

Each electropolished lot ships with its internal Ra report and an EN 10204 3.1 certificate linked to the heat number, plus PMI on every length, giving qualification teams documents they can file against the IQ protocol. Product details are on the electropolished pipes and electropolished tubes pages.

sections.heading: Delivery Across Ahmedabad District
paragraphs: Consignments for Changodar, Matoda, Naroda or Vatva travel by road from Mumbai with ends capped and lengths sleeved; dispatch and transit are confirmed in writing with each quotation.
